headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles complications, state’s third death this year
headlines.description: The 40-year-old woman died as the U.S. experiences its worst outbreak of the disease in 35 years.

headlines.title: CDC finds that nearly 3 in 4 U.S. adults report struggling with fatigue
headlines.description: A new CDC report reveals that fatigue is a widespread concern among U.S. adults, with nearly three-quarters reporting feeling very tired or exhausted on multiple days over the past three months. Board-certified sleep specialist Dr. Carol Ash explains the causes of fatigue and shares simple tips to improve sleep and boost energy.

headlines.title: How to Master Small Talk (and How it Can Make a Big Difference)
headlines.description: A recent survey found that 71% of Americans would rather sit in silence than engage in small talk, so psychiatrist Dr. Samantha Boardman stops by TODAY to talk about the big benefits of small talk. She explains the dangers of “phubbing,” shares tips for how to engage in casual conversations, and gives strategies for politely exiting them.

headlines.title: Former South Carolina QB on Fighting Colorectal Cancer at 38
headlines.description: Stephen Garcia, former star quarterback for the South Carolina Gamecocks, sits down with TODAY’s Craig Melvin to open up about being diagnosed with Stage 4 colorectal cancer at age 38. “It was definitely a shock,” he says, “but I wasn't going to sit there and be like, ‘Well, I guess I’m done.’ It’s more like, ‘What am I going to do? How am I going to beat this thing?”

headlines.title: Craig Melvin, Dylan Dreyer Talk ‘Bottoms Up’ Golf Invitational
headlines.description: TODAY’s Craig Melvin and Dylan Dreyer talk about the annual Bottoms Up Invitational, revealing they raised $1.3 million for the Colorectal Cancer Alliance.

headlines.title: The best space heaters for every kind of space
headlines.description: Need to buy a space heater? Here are expert tips for choosing the best space heater, including options from Dyson, Lasko, Jnrdo and other brands.

headlines.title: How to choose the right toothpaste for your child
headlines.description: Kids should start using a fluoride toothpaste as soon as their first tooth comes in — these are the best options.

headlines.title: Get 30% off this popular sunrise alarm clock
headlines.description: Save 30% on the Philips SmartSleep Wake-Up Light, a clinically proven sunrise alarm clock that helps you wake up gently as mornings get darker this fall.

headlines.title: Bar soaps vs. body wash — which is best for your skin?
headlines.description: Bar soaps work as effectively as body washes and I rounded up editor-approved picks from Dove, L’Occitane, Avène and more.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who’s feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.

headlines.title: Your health insurance bills are about to go up
headlines.description: Most Americans can expect to pay significantly more each month for health insurance next year, whether they get it through work, the Affordable Care Act or Medicare.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
